known_limitations: This delivery provides a CLI rather than a graphical interface.
It covers split, merge, extract, rotation, and basic interleaving, but not the full visual workspace or project persistence described in the reviewed requirements.
It does not implement advanced relinking, preview, batch profile, or command-line job profile workflows.
Interleaving only performs straightforward page-by-page alternation and does not enforce the full mismatch and layout safety checks from the specification.
